mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, canonical fourteen-period Williams %R returning inside its -80/-20 envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks an extreme range-location displacement beginning to normalize; follow the inward direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when %R crosses strictly above -80 after being at or below -80; short when it crosses strictly below -20 after being at or above -20
mechanism.why_distinct: Williams %R locates the completed close relative to the highest high and lowest low of fourteen uninterrupted bars and trades only envelope re-entry. It is not a stochastic line/signal crossover, DeMarker high/low expansion, RSI change smoothing, prior control, OI, flow, volume, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour close-in-range extreme re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.rolling_range: highest high and lowest low over latest 14 uninterrupted completed bars
features.reentry: current %R strictly crosses inward through -80 or -20 from immediately prior valid value
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Williams percent-R range-location re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no Williams %R period, formula, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: -100*(highest high over 14 periods-current close)/(highest high-lowest low); conventional -80/-20 envelope re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published period, formula, levels, and inward direction only; no incidence or outcomes
